repaired_issue.title: Let table-header inline-code spans inherit the header text color
repaired_issue.cause: The prior inline-code markup forced #40546A even inside white table headers on #234B65 backgrounds.
repaired_issue.reviewed_change: inline now has a default #40546A code_color and omits only the code-span color attribute when code_color is None. Both recursive inline calls propagate that setting. Only the table header path selects None; body cells retain the default.
repaired_issue.test_evidence: The regression builds a synthetic table and reparses the actual emitted header/body Paragraph markup and styles. Effective G_comp and nested-bold G_res header fragments are white; matching body fragments remain #40546A.
repaired_issue.result: Resolved within the focused source scope.

minimality.assessment: The inspected changes affect inline-code color selection and its table-header call site plus one synthetic regression. No formula, scientific-data, plot, margin, table-width, font-size or pagination change is present in the reviewed paths.
minimality.verification_boundary: Review compared current source with the prior source text reviewed in this session. A stored byte-for-byte historical source snapshot was not available; the recorded old and new hashes identify the two revisions.
